en: Black‑and‑white view of a large cobblestoned town square bordered by historic buildings. On the right is an ornate town‑hall‑like structure with a tall clock tower, steep gabled roof, statues, and a grand staircase leading up to an arched entrance. Smaller townhouses adjoin it. On the left side stand two simpler, rectangular buildings with hipped roofs and arched doorways; faint lettering is visible on their façades. The square itself is mostly empty except for a few distant figures, suggesting an early‑20th‑century European setting.
